title: TensorPlate Scheduler Event
description:
Bounded event record emitted by the v0.1.0 InferScheduler on admission, dispatch, completion, cancellation, expiry, and pressure transitions. Mirrors include/tensorplate/scheduler/scheduler.hpp::SchedulerEvent.

The scheduler emits one event per state transition. Labels are explicit fields so downstream observability (V01-E12) can scrape them without parsing free text. Slow event subscribers cannot block scheduler critical-path methods (admit / next / on_completion / cancel / expire_due / on_pressure / shutdown): the scheduler invokes the sink inside a defensive try/catch and never blocks on it.

This schema intentionally does NOT carry raw payload bytes, BufferRef ids, or per-request labels beyond the bounded fields below.

request_id.description: Originating request id. Empty for some pressure events.

endpoint.description: Routing identity from the request envelope.

backend_name.description: Adapter that owns or would own the request. Stable, low-cardinality label.

model_id.description: Model identifier from the request envelope. Empty for pressure events.

policy.description: Stable scheduler policy label echoed on every event.

error_code.description: Optional bounded error code carried on rejection / expiry / cancellation events.

pressure_severity.description: Populated for 'memory_pressure' / 'thermal_pressure' events and for pressure-related rejections.

wait_time_ns.description: Monotonic wait time spent in the queue before the event fired. Populated on 'dispatched', 'cancelled', and 'expired' for queued requests; zero otherwise.

timestamp_unix_nanos.description: Monotonic timestamp captured by the scheduler when the event was recorded. Encoded as steady-clock time_since_epoch nanoseconds; not directly comparable to wall-clock timestamps but stable per process.
